## Steps

1. **Entry check.** Run `uv run rmf status <run>`: P-13 is the next action, and
   P-11, P-12 are done or out of scope.
   Entry criteria (from `framework/tasks/P.yaml`):
   - Information types (P-12) and the boundary and data flows (P-11) are documented.
   If one is not met, stop and journal a NOTE (`00-run-protocol.md`, stop conditions). Why:
   the task builds on those results, and working around a gap leaves claims nobody can
   trace.
2. **Read the inputs** listed in `## Inputs`, and the passages in `## Citations` that say
   what P-13 must achieve. The purpose in the header states the outcome.
   P-13 feeds MS-A (Milestone A, milestone); what it
   records must be ready for that event.
   Why: the playbook is generic, so the inputs and the cited text set the content.
3. **Interview** following `_shared/interviewing.md` (and `_shared/hybrid-mode.md` in a
   `hybrid` run). Start with the responsible (R) personas in `## Interviews`. Take the
   questions from each persona card's `## Question bank by step` for step P
   (Prepare) and point them at what the exit criteria in `## Done when` need and the
   inputs leave open.
   Write at least 1 interview file(s) with `task: P-13`.
   Why: answers are the evidence that artifacts cite (`INT-###.A#`).
4. **Write the outputs** in `## Outputs`, each file whole (INV-8), every claim traced per
   `_shared/tagging-and-traceability.md`:
   - **ART-INFOTYPES** (Information types and information life cycle, updated): Read `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md`, append `P-13` to
     `touched_by`, add a `## Information Life Cycle (P-13)` section with what this task
     established, and write the whole file back. Keep every earlier section.
     Rewrite `artifacts/data/infotypes.yaml` whole (schema `framework/schema/infotypes.schema.json`) when this task changes its records; keep the records other tasks wrote.
   Why: `rmf status` counts P-13 done only when every output lists it in `touched_by`.
5. **Leave `facts.yaml` alone.** P-13 writes no facts (INV-4).
6. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-13`,
   until 0 errors (INV-6).
7. **Journal** a CHECKPOINT (`## Journal and lessons`).

## Interviews

| Persona | Role | Interview |
|---|---|---|
| PER-PRIV (Component Privacy Officer) | R | start here, only when the system processes PII |
| PER-PM (Program Manager / System Owner) | R, A | start here |
| PER-IO (Information Owner / Steward) | R | start here |
| PER-CIO (DoD Component Chief Information Officer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-SPONSOR (Capability / Requirements Sponsor) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-ISSE (Information Systems Security Engineer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |
| PER-LSE (Lead Systems Engineer) | C | when the inputs leave a question in this role's area open |

At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-13`. Never make a persona answer
outside its role; ask the persona who would know, or record an assumption.

- ART-INFOTYPES (Information types and information life cycle): `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md`, `artifacts/data/infotypes.yaml`
- ART-BND (Authorization boundary, network architecture and data flows): `artifacts/ART-BND.md`, `artifacts/data/boundary.yaml`, `artifacts/data/nss-assessments.yaml`
- EXT-PRODUCT (Product material): files in the run's product directory, cited as
  `product/<path>#<anchor>`.
- ART-INV (Hardware and software inventory): `artifacts/ART-INV.md`, `artifacts/data/inventory.yaml`
- ART-ORG-CONTEXT (Organizational risk context): `artifacts/ART-ORG-CONTEXT.md`, `artifacts/data/org-context.yaml`, `artifacts/data/scrm-org.yaml`
- ART-STAKE (Stakeholder register): `artifacts/ART-STAKE.md`
- Only these: do not open other run files (`00-run-protocol.md`, step 4).

## Facts

P-13 writes no facts.

## Done when

- All stages of the information life cycle are identified and understood for each information type processed, stored or transmitted by the system (DoDI 8510.01 Table 1 outcome).
- infotypes.yaml records the life-cycle stages and components for every information type.
- `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md` lists P-13 in `touched_by`.
- At least 1 interview(s) with `task: P-13`.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task P-13` reports 0 errors.
